source.rule: PCC 24.50.050 flood hazard area edge extension
source.says: the boundary of the special flood hazard area will be extended until it intercepts the elevation contour equal to the base flood elevation
source.mapped_area: FEMA NFHL special flood hazard area as quadfit holds it (overlay_fema_sfha.geojson, 444 features near Portland)
source.bfe: NFHL MapServer layer 16 BFE lines (1034, units ["('Feet', 'NAVD88')"]); static BFE for AH; boundary ground where FEMA gives none
source.ground: USGS 1 m lidar DEM (lowest of each 2 x 2 m block), 10 m DEM where no lidar
source.edge: each feature's EDGE_FT 7.0 is one 2 m grid cell: the traced edge is good to a cell; outlines are grown 4 ft and holes filled before a 3.5 ft simplify, on a 1 ft grid
